metadata.title: Cluster — The Modern Employee Experience Platform
metadata.description: Connect, know, and grow with your organization. Cluster is the modern employee experience platform that brings together communication, knowledge management, and professional growth.

register.title: Create account
register.description: Create your Cluster workspace. Set up your organization and start connecting with your team.

directory.title: Directory
directory.description: Discover and connect with members of your organization. Search, filter, and view the org chart.

feed.title: Feed
feed.description: Stay up to date with your organization. See posts, announcements, and updates from your team.

areas.title: Areas
areas.description: Structure of the organization: areas, their managers and members.

positions.title: Positions
positions.description: Manage the catalog of professional positions. Admins can assign positions to users.

assignments.title: Assignments
assignments.description: Assign an area and a position to each member of the organization.

grow.title: Grow
grow.description: Courses, lessons and quizzes for your organization.

search.title: Search
search.description: Search across all knowledge base content. Find pages and documents.

know.title: Knowledge base
know.description: Find documentation, guides, and policies across your organization. Search, bookmark, and share knowledge.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in to your Cluster workspace. Access your organization's communication, knowledge base, and growth tools.

verify.title: Verify a certificate
verify.description: Check that a certificate issued through Cluster is valid.

space.title: Space
space.description: Browse pages and documents in this knowledge base space.

member.title: Member profile
member.description: View member profile details and information.

activity.title: Activity
activity.description: Recent changes made by admins and managers in your organization.

members.inviteFailed: The invitation email could not be sent
members.createdNoEmail: Member created, but the email could not be sent. Use “Resend invite”.
members.name: Name
members.deactivateBody: They are signed out right away and can't sign in until you reactivate them. Their content, course progress and certificates are kept.
members.inviteDescription: They will receive an email with a link to set their password.
members.noMatchBody: Try another name, email or status.
members.resetMfaBody: Use this when they lost their phone and their recovery codes. They are signed out everywhere, their password stops working and they get an email with a link to set a new one (valid for 24 hours); if their role requires two-step verification, they set it up again.

details.title: Member details

details.emailHint: The address they sign in with. Changing it signs them out everywhere and warns the old address.
details.employeeCodeHint: Your organization's own code for this person, unique in the organization.

members.areaHint: Optional. It decides where this person appears in the organization chart.
members.areaRequiredHint: Required for collaborators while main nodes are isolated.
members.areaRequiredError: Pick an area for this collaborator.

access.title: Access for {name}
access.bodyNoMail: This instance does not send e-mail. Hand the link or password over yourself, through a channel you trust. It is shown once.
access.bodyMail: Share it through a channel you trust. It is shown once.
access.bodyReset: {name} sets a new password with this link. Two-step verification still applies.
access.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it.
access.notAgain: It will not be shown again. If it is lost, create a new one.

nodeAccess.exportDescription: Downloads a spreadsheet with a fresh access link or initial password for each pending member of the area and everything below it. Active members are left out.

nodeAccess.linkNote: One link per person. Each works once, until it expires.

breachCheck.title: Passwords
breachCheck.label: Refuse passwords found in known data breaches
breachCheck.hint: When someone sets a password, Cluster asks Have I Been Pwned (api.pwnedpasswords.com) whether it was leaked. Only the first 5 characters of its SHA-1 hash are sent; the password never leaves the server. Needs internet access: if the service does not answer, the password is accepted.
